items.quote: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom
items.claim: The document says the men turned away from where they were and went toward Sodom. This is a claim made in the text, not a confirmed historical event.

items.quote: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD
items.claim: The document says Abraham stayed standing before the LORD after the men left. This is a claim made in the text, not a confirmed historical event.
